summary: BUG FIX VERIFIED — realtime chat delivery to admin works end-to-end. Backend: 9/9 pytest passed in /app/backend/tests/test_chat_realtime_admin.py — (1) buyer socket-emitted message reaches a connected admin who NEVER joined the buyer room (new 'admins' broadcast room on connect); (2) REST POST /api/chat/send also broadcasts to the admins room; (3) admin socket reply reaches buyer in realtime; (4) buyer joining a foreign room is correctly ignored (no leak); (5) unread badge: buyer msg increments admin unread (global + per-room via /api/chat/rooms), POST /api/chat/read {room} zeroes the room and drops the global count by exactly that amount; buyer-side unread counts admin replies and read resets to 0; (6) 400s for admin send/read without room and empty message. Verified python-socketio 5.16.4 get_participants() natively supports list-of-rooms, so emit(room=[buyer_room,'admins']) is valid. Frontend E2E with TWO simultaneous browser sessions (admin on /dashboard/chat, buyer on /chat): buyer sends msg -> admin room list updates in realtime WITHOUT navigation (new last_text + unread badge '1' appears, screenshot admin_list_realtime.png); buyer sees own echo instantly; admin opens room -> buyer's next message appears instantly in the open conversation (admin_room_realtime2.png); admin replies -> buyer receives in realtime (buyer_got_reply2.png); both sides see own echoes; after read, badge cleared and room preview shows the admin reply as last activity. No red screens, no console errors on either session. The original bug ('Admin tidak terima chat') is resolved.
action_items: None for this bug. Optional hardening only: socket 'message' handler accepts unbounded text with no length cap/trim (REST has none either) — consider a max length; server.py now 1280 lines (auth/orders/chat/socket in one file) — split into modules per 700-line guideline.
critical_code_review_comments: emit(room=[room,'admins']) is safe: python-socketio 5.16.4 BaseManager.get_participants() explicitly handles list rooms (union of participants).
chat.tsx cleanup correctly removes only its own named 'message'/'connect' listeners, so the dashboard listener survives navigation — verified working in the two-session E2E.

Minor: chat.tsx useEffect socket-setup depends only on [room] and reads user?.user_id from closure — fine in practice since user doesn't change mid-screen, but worth noting if user switching without unmount ever happens.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows (7/7 E2E assertions passed)

Socket path is /api/socket.io on the public origin, auth via auth={token}. UI multi-session pattern: browser = page.context.browser; bctx = await browser.new_context(...); inject token with add_init_script localStorage.setItem('diana_session_token', JSON.stringify(token)) before goto. RN-web FlatList keeps hidden duplicates of visible text in the DOM — for text assertions inside chat lists use a getBoundingClientRect-based wait_for_function visibility check, not text= selectors. Key testIDs: chat-input, chat-send, chat-image, chat-back, chat-room-<uid>, unread-<uid>.
rca_of_issue: Original bug: server only emitted 'message' events to the buyer's room, so admins not currently inside that room received nothing; admin room list also only refreshed on screen focus. Fix (verified working): (1) socket connect handler puts admin sockets into an 'admins' broadcast room (server.py:1247-1250); (2) both the socket 'message' handler (server.py:1274) and REST POST /api/chat/send (server.py:1009) emit to room=[buyer_room,'admins']; (3) dashboard/chat.tsx listens on the shared socket and invalidates ['chat','rooms']+['chat','unread'] on any 'message'; (4) chat.tsx cleanup removes only its own named listeners. Confirmed via python socketio client tests AND two-browser-session UI E2E: admin list updates with new message + unread badge without any navigation.
